criteria.name: specificity
criteria.description: The character has concrete, named details — specific motivation, named flaw, distinct personality traits. Not archetype placeholders or generic descriptors.

criteria.name: internal_consistency
criteria.description: description, personality, motivation, and conflict are coherent — the character's flaw creates the conflict, the motivation explains the goal. No contradictions.

criteria.name: visual_distinctness
criteria.description: The appearance is specific enough to generate a recognizable portrait — age, build, distinctive features, clothing style. Not a stock description.

criteria.name: voice_specificity
criteria.description: speech_patterns describe how this specific person talks — not just 'formal' or 'casual'. Sentence rhythm, vocabulary range, verbal habits, what they avoid.
